source_en: Sorry, I look tired. Irina Kakulia, student nurse. The ward energy's heavy.
I live with my grandmother now. Mzia, the seamstress, southern block.
She says she's fine, the way she talks about her sewing. I mostly believe her.
The universe keeps handing us more than we think we can hold.
My [[infected:hands shake a little]]. The air, I think. Or mercury retrograde.
Ask the polyclinic. They say smog. They also say stay calm and queue.
They ask what's happening. I tell them to breathe through it.
Breathe, officer. You're holding it in.
